requirement: Pedals shall have tread surfaces on both sides or be designed to self-right. The tread surface shall have anti-slip properties. Pedals shall not have exposed sharp edges.
requirement_summary: Pedals must have anti-slip tread on both sides or self-right, no sharp edges

evidence_required.description: Product photo showing pedal tread surfaces on both sides or self-righting design

remediation: Replace pedals with dual-tread or self-righting pedals with anti-slip surfaces per §1512.7(a).

requirement: Pedal reflectors, when required, shall be essentially colorless or amber on the front and rear surfaces of each pedal, and shall meet the photometric requirements of §1512.16(e).
requirement_summary: Pedal reflectors must be colorless or amber, meeting §1512.16(e) photometric requirements

evidence_required.description: BOM must show pedal assemblies include reflector devices
Pedal reflector photometric test report per §1512.16(e)

remediation: Equip each pedal with essentially colorless or amber reflectors meeting §1512.16(e) photometric requirements.
